title: Purchase Request Intake Form
use_case: Use the intake form during internal purchase request and authorization when the purchase request record must identify requester, department, supplier, goods or services, quantity, needed-by date, location, and accounting dimensions. Complete the applicable handoff for purchase-order reference, committed amount, receiving owner, invoice instructions, asset tagging, and request closure.
